title: 1973–74 radar station crew see a cigar-shaped object
place_text: Mountain radar station in northern Sweden

tellings.quote:
and I interviewed six uh people at the
radar station in the very north of
Sweden.

plain: In 1973 or 1974, the crew of a mountain radar station in the far north of Sweden are said to have seen a cigar-shaped object. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells it from his own interviews, saying he spoke with six people at the station. If true, it would be a sighting by trained military radar staff.
